## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: canon entries from USWDS forms, GOV.UK error/form patterns, VA.gov error anatomy, 18F content guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines, CDC reading-level guidance exist in the reference-library corpus with stable rule_ids

## Description
Author exactly 6 federal-style canon source YAMLs under plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/:
- uswds-forms.yaml — rule_ids namespaced uswds-forms.*
- govuk-errors-forms.yaml — rule_ids namespaced govuk.*
- vagov-error-anatomy.yaml — rule_ids namespaced vagov.*
- eighteen-f-content.yaml — rule_ids namespaced eighteen-f.*
- federal-plain-language.yaml — rule_ids namespaced fpl.*
- cdc-reading-level.yaml — rule_ids namespaced cdc.*

Each YAML carries: tags.domain: canon; hard_constraint per entry (true for errors/validation/legal-disclosure entries; false for stylistic/preference entries); source-provenance frontmatter source.url, source.retrieval_date, source.license, source.version_pin.

Conforms to corpus schema after task-A's edits land.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] All 6 federal-style canon YAMLs exist
  Verify: for f in uswds-forms govuk-errors-forms vagov-error-anatomy eighteen-f-content federal-plain-language cdc-reading-level; do test -f "plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/${f}.yaml" || exit 1; done
- [ ] Each YAML parses as valid YAML
  Verify: for f in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/*.yaml; do python3 -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open('$f'))" || exit 1; done
- [ ] Each YAML passes check-corpus-schema.py validation
  Verify: python3 plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/
- [ ] Each YAML declares domain==canon
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml,glob; assert all(((d:=yaml.safe_load(open(p))).get('tags',{}).get('domain')=='canon') or ('canon' in d.get('tags',{}).get('domain',[])) for p in glob.glob('plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/*.yaml') if not p.endswith('_overview.yaml'))"
- [ ] Each YAML carries source-provenance frontmatter
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-canon-source-yamls.sh
- [ ] Both hard_constraint:true and hard_constraint:false entries present across the corpus
  Verify: grep -rq 'hard_constraint: true' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/ && grep -rq 'hard_constraint: false' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/
- [ ] rule_ids namespaced per source prefix
  Verify: grep -q 'uswds-forms\\.' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/uswds-forms.yaml && grep -q 'govuk\\.' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/govuk-errors-forms.yaml && grep -q 'vagov\\.' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/vagov-error-anatomy.yaml && grep -q 'eighteen-f\\.' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/eighteen-f-content.yaml && grep -q 'fpl\\.' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/federal-plain-language.yaml && grep -q 'cdc\\.' plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/canon/cdc-reading-level.yaml

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
